verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence says Kimi drives a web browser, meaning navigating, clicking or filling forms on websites, on the user's behalf. A browser extension is listed only as a help-page title with no description of what it does. Agent mode, deep research and web search are related features, but none of them is documented as operating a browser, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
